note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Nicaragua: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A resident's annual taxable income is free to NIO 100,000, then taxed at 15% to 200,000, 20% to 350,000, 25% to 500,000 and 30% above; only Nicaraguan-source income is taxed; there is no regional layer.

sources.said: Taxable income (NIO*) Minimum tax charge (NIO) Tax on excess (%) Over Not over 0 100,000 0 0 100,000 200,000 0 15 200,000 350,000 15,000 20 350,000 500,000 45,000 25 500,000 and above 82,500 30
Nicaragua taxes its citizens and all residents and non-residents on their income originating in Nicaragua.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; an annual return (IR-106) is due within 90 days of year-end (by 31 March) from those who must file; a single-employer employee need not file.

sources.said: The tax year in Nicaragua is the calendar year.
The taxpayer should submit the annual income tax return within 90 days after year-end.

figures.finding: Social security (INSS) is 7% of gross pay from the employee and 21.5% from the employer (22.5% with more than 50 employees).

sources.said: Social security contributions exist at 7.00% for employees and 21.50% for employers with 50 or less employees and 22.50% if greater than 50 employees, and are determined on the gross salaries and wages.

figures.finding: The employer withholds income tax monthly through payroll; payments for an individual's professional services bear 10% at source, and royalties to residents 15%.

sources.said: The employer, through the payroll, is responsible to withhold and pay the income tax on a monthly basis through withholding income tax return Form IR-122.
Professional services provided by an individual are subject to 10% WHT.

figures.finding: A non-resident receiving Nicaraguan-source income pays a definitive 20% withholding (15% on royalties).

value.base: gross income (as a percentage set by type)

sources.said: Non-residents, whether domiciled or not, who receive Nicaraguan-source income are subject to a 20% definitive WHT.

figures.finding: Royalties bear 15% at source whether paid to a resident or a non-resident; no special regime for authors was found.

sources.said: Payments of royalties to resident individuals or corporations are subject to 15% WHT.

figures.finding: VAT is 15% on services and goods; the registration threshold for a freelancer was not found.

sources.said: VAT is imposed at a 15% rate on the sale of goods, rendering of services, grant of use of assets, and import of goods.
